name: @wy51ai/edulab
description: A Claude Code plugin: a collection of education skills that turn academic problems into interactive lesson web pages and explainer videos. Elementary skills (zero-dependency native Canvas 2D, answer-first integer sampling, stdlib only): edu-primary-applied (62 primary word-problem types), edu-primary-geometry (9 shape-and-measure types with a draggable canvas), edu-statistics (bar charts + probability trees), edu-motion-problems (pursuit / meeting / circular-track). Secondary / advanced: edu-solid-geometry (3D Three.js + MathJax), edu-analytic-geometry (conic sections, sympy + Canvas + KaTeX), edu-chem-reaction (microscopic 3D reaction demos), and video skills edu-math-video / edu-physics-video / edu-chem-video (GLM-TTS narrated canvas animation rendered to MP4).
author: WY (@akokoi1) (https://x.com/akokoi1)
